name: Delivery and Metrics: Flow, DORA and Incidents
summary: Answering "when will it be ready" and "how are we doing" with something other than an opinion: flow, the four DORA metrics, incidents, and the on-call rota somebody has to carry.
prerequisites: Requires process and estimation. It assumes you have shipped software in a team with a pipeline and production — it does not teach deployment, it teaches how to measure and decide.
syllabus: Flow: work in progress, queues and cycle time
